turns.text: I'm trying to figure out where I should study this semester.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is my bedroom desk, which is quiet but right next to my bed and my phone charger.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is the campus library, a twenty minute walk, but nobody bothers me there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's the coffee shop downstairs, a bit noisy, but I always feel weirdly focused there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the full list. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The library sounds like the best bet for deep work, the walk even gives you a little break. The coffee shop is great if the background noise actually helps you. Your bedroom is the riskiest, with the bed and phone so close.
